title: Customizable Select – Classic 2: Hide the real select, build a fake one
description: A hidden real <select> keeps the form value; a combobox + listbox mirror it: open/close, selection, keyboard (arrows, Home/End, Enter/Space, Escape, type-ahead), disabled options, label click, form reset.
